title: Townsend Brown possibly involved in a crash recovery

tellings.quote: I have some evidence that Towns and Brown may have been involved in a UFO crash recovery,

plain: The American inventor Thomas Townsend Brown may have taken part in recovering a crashed UFO, Michels says. He brings this up on a 2026 episode with a NASA whistleblower and says he has "some evidence" for it, but he does not say what that evidence is. If true, it would place Brown among the people who handled the wreckage of a craft that was not built by humans.
